reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in our DM to confirm that Gate 40 is now the dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups. I said I'd keep it to that DM, so that message is the only record of it.

I didn't save it to my long-term memory on purpose. That memory loads into every conversation I have, including ones with other members, so storing it there could leak something Hollis told me privately, which rule 2 forbids. If it's needed later, it can be read back from the DM history.
